label: reuse pinned input-ID staging buffers
hypothesis: Replace a fresh pageable CPU ID tensor on every GPU-input call with a preallocated pinned int64 staging buffer per cached offloader, preserving synchronous readiness before embedding and CPU gather.
expected_bottleneck: Fresh GPU-to-CPU ID staging allocation and pageable transfer overhead; isolated b8 prefill staging 0.0134 ms versus 0.0069 ms with reusable pinned storage.
change: One bounded pinned ID tensor per cached shape; blocking copy before embedding; input-stage/model-call lock prevents concurrent reuse. No lookup/output caching, no embedding reorder or new transfer stream.
tradeoffs: Pinned IDs add batch*length*8 bytes per cached offloader; include in host capacity counters.
Small staging gain can disappear into model variability or locking overhead.
